design_plan.boldness_derivation: 初学者向けの正確な静的教材
design_plan.signature_move: deliberately restrained: repeated native number cells retain their coordinate while the candidate range narrows; clarity before novelty
design_plan.form_ledger: native array diagrams on 3/5 slides; chart on 1/5; textual recap on 1/5
design_plan.icon_family: none — numeric array entries are data, not pictographic categories; icons would add a second code to decode
design_plan.palette: TEXT-safe #132C3B on #FFFFFF; #116B8A and #A8471C accents; white on strong filled cells; FILL-only #E8EEF0 #D8EAF0 #F2F5F6
